evidence_items.locator: Section 4, BERT Learns Statistical Features, opening sentence
evidence_items.explanation: Zhang and colleagues, including van den Broeck, found near-perfect performance within a training distribution but substantial failures under different sampling of the same logical problem space. Their analysis attributes this to statistical features rather than acquisition of the intended reasoning procedure.

Gururangan and colleagues found that labels could often be predicted without the premise needed for genuine inference. High-performing models also performed much worse on the subset where that shortcut failed, providing an independent earlier example.
